name: Portent
oracle_text:
Look at the top three cards of target player's library, then put them back in any order. You may have that player shuffle.
Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
blocked_sentences: Look at the top three cards of target player's library, then put them back in any order.

needs.what: A way for look_at_top to put the cards looked at and not taken back on top of the library in an order the resolving player chooses (rule 401.4, as put_on_top's any_order does via _in_owners_order) -- here with nothing taken: look at the top three of a TARGET player's library (player: {"target": "t1"}), and the caster (not the library's owner) reorders all three back on top
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top leaves untaken cards on top in their original order, so the printed ordering choice never happens; rest_to_bottom sends them to the bottom in random order and rest_to only names a zone; put_on_top has any_order but no selector names 'the top three cards of that library', and its any_order asks the owner rather than the caster; scry orders the top but also allows bottoming, a strictly better card (Ponder's shipped scry spelling is that approximation). The rest is expressible: 'You may have that player shuffle' is may + shuffle with player {"target": "t1"}, and the draw is delay with step upkeep (as Arcane Denial)
